metadata.description: World-state knowledge items for KBD (Knowledge Boundary Drift, README C1). Each item's visible_to is a flat archetype set — no hierarchy, no propagation. Hand-authored, original content, no external source.

items.fact: There is an ongoing investigation into a string of break-ins on Elm Street.
The precinct is getting new body cameras next month.
A confidential informant tipped off the department about a planned robbery downtown.
The pharmacy's regular supplier delayed this week's shipment of insulin.
A patient's prescription was flagged for a dangerous drug interaction this morning.
The university's tenure review committee meets this Friday to decide three cases.
A student filed a plagiarism complaint against another student last week.
The bar is switching to a new liquor distributor because of a pricing dispute.
A regular customer ran up a large unpaid tab that management wants collected quietly.
A client's custody case is going to a contentious hearing next week.
The agency is short-staffed this month because two caseworkers quit.
A supplier offered the shop owner a bulk discount that expires Friday.
The shop was targeted by a shoplifting ring last month and lost significant inventory.
The company's quarterly earnings report next week will show a significant loss.
A round of layoffs is planned for next month but hasn't been announced yet.
Management is planning to cut hours for part-time staff starting next month.
A coworker was caught taking cash from the register and quietly let go.
